svg.aria-label: RuACT: Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
svg.title: RuACT: Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
svg.desc: Ordinary rollouts identify inactive rubrics. A rubric-conditioned teacher response is used only for the reward gate. Accepted groups distill frozen teacher probabilities on the best ordinary rollout prefixes into the trainable student. Saturated rubrics are decomposed and screened on the same ordinary rollouts, while preserving their weight budget. Informative rewards are retained. GRPO and distillation losses are summed before a single policy update.

g.aria-label: R(guided) greater than max ordinary reward: yes enables distillation; no sets the distillation loss to zero, without cancelling GRPO or critic refinement.
